summary: Keep exact JSON numbers when --agent/--compact compaction and human object output re-encode responses.
reason: Compaction decoded responses into float64, so integers above 2^53 (for example large SEC XBRL fact values) could be silently rounded in agent output. Decoding with UseNumber preserves the original number tokens.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passes; new tests confirm 9007199254740993 survives object and list compaction and human object output unchanged.
